(2) Exterior shot: A yellow house-style building with a circular blue sign reading 'JULIEN' and a menu board out front. (3) Restaurant interior: High vaulted wooden ceilings with a white chandelier. The space is filled with plants, white walls, and camping-style chairs and tables. The video ends with a group photo of the family.
